components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary save, create, approve, and selected-state action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#082a17; background:#4ade80; border:1px solid #4ade80; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .2s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(.93); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: Default secondary action on the dark operational surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; background:#191e29; border:1px solid #445166; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background:#222938; border-color:#b0bdcd; } .ds-btn-neutral:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Outlined destructive action that fills only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f19a91; background:transparent; border:1px solid #f19a91; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:color .2s ease,background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { color:#10121c; background:#f19a91; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Visible label paired with a full-width 44px operational input.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font:600 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; } .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px; font:400 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; caret-color:#4ade80; background:#191e29; border:1px solid #445166; border-radius:8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#b0bdcd; opacity:1; } .ds-input:hover { background:#222938; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Version Badge
components.description: Compact neutral metadata for lifecycle state and record version.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:2px 9px; font:600 14px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; background:#10121c; border:1px solid #445166; border-radius:6px; } .ds-badge:hover { background:#191e29; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Billing Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container for the clinical billing workbench.
components.html:
Billing workspace

Review services and tariff versions.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:24px; font:400 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; background:#10121c; border:1px solid #445166; border-radius:14px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0; font-size:22px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-panel p { margin:8px 0 0; color:#b0bdcd; } @media (max-width:640px) { .ds-panel { padding:16px; } }

components.name: Inline Details
components.description: Native progressive disclosure for record detail and history.
components.html:
Details

Source and version information stays in context.
components.css: .ds-details { font:400 16px/1.5 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f0f3f8; border-top:1px solid #445166; } .ds-details summary { padding:10px 0; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-details summary:hover { color:#4ade80; } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #4ade80; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-details p { margin:8px 0 16px; color:#b0bdcd; }

narrative.overview:
Anima Cura is a restrained clinical operations workspace: calm enough for sustained administrative work, explicit enough for billing decisions, and dense only where the task requires it. Neutral light and dark layers establish hierarchy; borders, spacing, and typography do more work than decoration.

The billing workspace extends the incumbent dashboard with a deliberately utilitarian surface. It keeps labels visible, exposes additional detail inline, and reserves color for state and action rather than atmosphere.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, high-contrast light and dark operational surfaces.
Green reserved for selected, primary, focus, and success states.
Readable 16px body copy and labeled 44px controls.
Progressive disclosure stays in context through details, editors, and review panels.
Responsive two-column forms collapse to one column on mobile.

rules.name: The Operational Green Rule
rules.body: Green means selected, primary, focused, or successful; do not use it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Visible Boundary Rule
rules.body: Inputs, controls, and status regions retain a discernible border in both themes.

rules.name: The Read-Once Rule
rules.body: Operational body text and form labels remain readable at 16px; compact metadata may step down to 14px but cannot replace a visible label.

rules.name: The In-Context Rule
rules.body: Editors, approval decisions, history, and source detail replace or expand within the workspace instead of opening detached overlays.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to billing fields, action groups, notices, or list rows; preserve depth through surfaces and borders.

dos: Do keep operational body copy and visible form labels at 16px.
Do preserve 44px minimum heights for buttons, inputs, text areas, and selects.
Do use green only for selected, primary, focus, and success meaning.
Do keep destructive actions red, outlined, and visually separate from the primary path.
Do collapse two-column forms and definition lists to one column at 640px.
Do disclose details, editing, and confirmation inline where their record context remains visible.
donts: Don't use green as decorative ambient color inside the billing workspace.
Don't remove labels in favor of placeholder-only fields or icon-only operational actions.
Don't introduce modal detours for detail, history, revision, or approval flows already handled inline.
Don't add shadows to billing controls, list rows, or status regions.
Don't compress action controls below their 44px target or preserve two columns on narrow screens.
